tax.text: She says she would cut taxes for working families and small businesses.
tax.quote: Shannon will fight to cut taxes for working families and small businesses – not for billionaires and corporate special interests.

trade.text: She says she would oppose tariffs that raise costs and hurt farmers.
trade.quote: I will also fight against these tariffs and foreign wars that are raising costs across the district and hurting our farmers.

debt.text: She says she would protect Social Security and Medicare for seniors.
debt.quote: Shannon will fight to make medical billing transparent by ending surprise billing, and fight to protect Social Security and Medicare for seniors who have paid into them their entire adult life.

abortion.text: After Roe v. Wade was overturned, she defended Virginians' access to abortion care.
abortion.quote: When Roe v. Wade was overturned, Shannon was one of the first prosecutors in the country to defend the right for Virginia women to have the freedom to access abortion care.

health.text: She supports restoring the Affordable Care Act and opposes privatizing Medicare and Medicaid.
health.quote: I will fight to restore the Affordable Care Act to ensure that rural hospitals and clinics get the funding they need. I will fight to lower the cost of prescription drugs, make medical billing transparent, and oppose the privatization of Medicare and Medicaid.

energy.text: She says data centers should cover their energy costs so residents do not pay more.
energy.quote: No Virginian should pay a dime more for energy or water because of data centers. If they cannot meet that requirement, they shouldn’t be built.

tax.text: He supports tax relief for working families and lower taxes for small businesses.
tax.quote: I supported tax relief for working families, including locking in and doubling the Child Tax Credit, increasing the standard deduction to $31,500 for families, and no tax on qualifying tips and overtime.

safety.text: He calls for resources to equip local departments and strengthen law enforcement coordination.
safety.quote: I will continue fighting for resources that help local departments improve emergency communications, replace outdated equipment, combat violent crime, and strengthen coordination among local, state, and federal law enforcement.

immigration.text: He supports secure borders and enforcement of immigration laws, including stronger detention requirements for some people in the country illegally.
immigration.quote: We can welcome people who come here legally while insisting that our borders are secure and our immigration laws are enforced.
